name: Zoho Books
label: Zoho Books — Zoho Books API v3
description: Official Zoho Books API v3. Docs: https://www.zoho.com/books/api/v3/introduction/. One node; operations via `operation`. Distinct from Zoho CRM. No PAN. organization_id required. Data centers: com | eu | in | com.au | jp | sa | ca | com.cn. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Zoho Books. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: contact_create | invoice_create | invoice_get | payment_create | bill_create | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: contact_name
schema.description: Display name. Required on contact_create. Example: Acme Corp.

schema.label: customer_id
schema.description: Customer contact id. Required on invoice_create and payment_create. Example: 8527119000000099001.

schema.label: line_items
schema.description: Line items [{item_id, quantity, rate}] for invoice_create / bill_create. Required. Example: [{"item_id":"…","quantity":1,"rate":100}].

schema.label: invoice_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `invoice_id` for operation: invoice_get. Required by: invoice_get.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Payment amount. Required on payment_create. Example: 150.00.

schema.label: vendor_id
schema.description: Vendor contact id. Required on bill_create.

schema.label: contact_type
schema.description: Zoho Books contact type. EXACT: customer | vendor. contact_create. Example: customer. https://www.zoho.com/books/api/v3/contacts/

schema.label: company_name
schema.description: Legal company name. contact_create. Example: Acme Corp.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email. contact_create. PII — do not log. Example: billing@example.com.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Contact phone. contact_create. PII — do not log.

schema.label: billing_address
schema.description: Billing address {address,city,state,zip,country}. contact_create.

schema.label: shipping_address
schema.description: Shipping address {address,city,state,zip,country}. contact_create.

schema.label: contact_persons
schema.description: Contact persons [{first_name,last_name,email,phone}]. contact_create.

schema.label: payment_terms
schema.description: Net payment days. contact_create and invoice_create. Example: 15.

schema.label: invoice_number
schema.description: Invoice number. invoice_create. Auto-generated when omitted. Max 100 chars.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Document date YYYY-MM-DD. invoice_create, payment_create, bill_create. Example: 2026-01-15.

schema.label: due_date
schema.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD. invoice_create / bill_create.

schema.label: notes
schema.description: Notes on invoice_create or bill_create.

schema.label: currency_id
schema.description: Zoho currency id for invoice_create when not using the org default.

schema.label: payment_mode
schema.description: payment_create. EXACT: check | cash | creditcard | banktransfer | bankremittance | autotransaction | others. Required by Zoho. Example: banktransfer.

schema.label: invoices
schema.description: payment_create invoices [{invoice_id, amount_applied}]. Required by Zoho. Example: [{"invoice_id":"123","amount_applied":50}].

schema.label: reference_number
schema.description: Payment reference. payment_create. Max 100 chars.

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: Deposit account id for payment_create.

schema.label: bill_number
schema.description: Vendor bill number. bill_create. Example: BILL-001.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Payment description / notes. payment_create. Example: Invoice settlement.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: Http Status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: contact_create | invoice_create | invoice_get | payment_create | bill_create | trigger. Default contact_create. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
